{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (sentinel value)
print('Rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {}'.format((df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()))
df_clean = df[~(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999)].copy()

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
print('Total rows before deduplication: {}'.format(len(df_clean)))
df_dedup = df_clean.sort_values(by="sample_seq", ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")
print('Total rows after deduplication: {}'.format(len(df_dedup)))

# Step 3: Verify arm and severity distribution after deduplication
print('Arm distribution after deduplication:\n{}'.format(df_dedup["arm"].value_counts()))
print('Severity distribution after deduplication:\n{}'.format(df_dedup["severity"].value_counts()))

# Step 4: Compute response rates by arm
response_by_arm = df_dedup.groupby("arm")["responded"].mean()
print('Response rate by arm:\n{}'.format(response_by_arm))

# Step 5: Compute treatment effect as difference in proportions (treatment - control)
treatment_rate = response_by_arm["treatment"]
control_rate = response_by_arm["control"]
treatment_effect = treatment_rate - control_rate

# Output results
treatment_effect"}
